title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
🌱 Digital Marketing Executive
 
**VM Global Impex LLP \| Tiruppur \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site** 




**VM Global Impex LLP is a growing manufacturer and exporter of cocopeat, coir substrates and horticulture products** 
 serving customers in India and international markets.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Digital Marketing Executive** 
 to support our marketing and customer communication activities.
 


 💼 What You Will Do
 * Manage
 **LinkedIn and social media pages**
* **Create and post marketing content and posters using Canva**
* **Handle website content and product updates**
* **Respond to online enquiries and customer messages**
* **Handle and follow up IndiaMART leads**
* **Build new LinkedIn connections and B2B leads**
* **Support email marketing and customer communication**
* **Track basic social media and marketing performance**
* **Research competitors and new market opportunities**


 🎓 Who Can Apply?
 * **Freshers \& Experienced candidates can apply**
* **Degree/Diploma in Marketing, Business, Commerce or related field preferred**
* **Good English communication and writing skills**
* **Basic computer and internet knowledge**
* **Interest in Digital Marketing \& Sales**
* **Canva knowledge is an advantage**
* **Hindi speaking/understanding is preferred**


 🌟 Freshers Welcome!
 
**No previous export experience is required.** 




**We will provide training and guide you to handle the regular work.**

**Location:** 
 Tiruppur
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time, On\-Site
 



**Joining:** 
 Immediate
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹15,000 – ₹22,000 \+ Performance Incentives

 mkt@vmimpex.in

title: Social Media Manager
description:
* Develop and execute
 **social media strategies** 
 to grow existing communities and increase engagement.
* Stay updated with the latest
 **social media trends, formats, tools, and platform innovations** 
 and turn relevant trends into content opportunities.
* Plan and create engaging
 **photo, video, graphic, and written content** 
 for social media platforms.
* Design and develop
 **visual presentations and creative assets** 
 for advertising, social media, communities, and brand websites.
* Manage and maintain the brand’s
 **social media channels, online communities, and website content** 
 .
* Understand the brand’s audience and translate their needs, interests, and expectations into relevant content.
* Use
 **visual and written communication effectively** 
 to tell the brand story.
* Engage with customers, followers, creators, and industry peers across social platforms.
* Monitor social media performance and identify opportunities to improve
 **reach, engagement, and community growth** 
 .



  




 What we’re looking for
 * **3\+ years of experience** 
 in social media marketing, content creation, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of major social media platforms and their content formats.
* Hands\-on experience creating
 **social media content, especially photo and video content** 
 .
* Good visual sense with an understanding of branding, design, and storytelling.
* Strong written communication and copywriting skills.
* Ability to understand a brand’s tone, audience, and visual identity.
* Creative thinker who can develop fresh content ideas while also executing them independently.
* Ability to follow trends without simply copying them — and identify what is relevant for the brand.
* Experience with creative/design or video editing tools is a plus.
* A portfolio of previous social media/content work is preferred.



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work Location:** 
 In person
 



**Location:** 
 Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu – 641601
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month

title: Reporting Senior Analyst - Marketing
description:
**Reporting Senior Analyst**
**Experience:** 
 3\-5 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Reporting Senior Analyst will play a critical role in measuring, analyzing, and reporting marketing performance across channels to support data‑driven decision‑making. This role is responsible for delivering end‑to‑end marketing analytics, including web, email, paid media, ABM, social, SEO and event performance, with a strong focus on
 **MQL tracking, funnel metrics, and CRM** 
 ‑
 **driven reporting** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong analytical rigor, hands\-on experience with modern marketing analytics tools, and the ability to monitor, measure and analyze data for insights actionable for marketing and leadership teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Marketing Performance Measurement**
* Measure and analyze core marketing metrics across channels, including:
+ Web performance
+ Email marketing metrics
+ Social media performance
+ Event marketing effectiveness
+ Paid media metrics and ROI
+ Search and AI attribution performance

* Track digital revenue generation in Dynamics 365 (D365\) / CRM metrics, including MQLs, funnel progression, and pipeline contribution


**Reporting, Dashboards \& Insights**
* Support data aggregation and enrichment, and dat hygeine, maintenance and best practices across integrated systems.
* Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and recurring reports for marketing, sales, and leadership stakeholders
* Deliver insights on campaign performance, channel effectiveness, and account‑level engagement
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and clear documentation of metrics and definitions


**ABM, CRM \& Attribution Analysis**
* Support ABM reporting and analysis using HubSpot and 6sense
* Track account engagement, intent signals, and scoring models
* Support lifecycle reporting, attribution models, and custom property analysis within HubSpot
* Align CRM and marketing data to provide end\-to\-end visibility into demand generation performanceWork with cross‑functional teams to ensure clean data flows between platforms
* Identify opportunities to streamline reporting and improve efficiency through automation


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Analytics \& Tools Expertise**
* Strong hands‑on experience with GA4 Analytics, Search Console and Data Studio
* Experience with campaign performance reporting such as HubSpot analytics, including dashboards, lifecycle reports, attribution, and custom properties
* Experience with enterprise ABMintent data, account engagement scoring, dashboards, and segmentation a plus
* Experience with data visualization or AI enabled data analysis a plus.
* Experience with advanced analytics platforms such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus


**Data \& Excel Skills**
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, and scenario analysis
* Ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets with high accuracy


**Professional Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights
* Advanced understand of the unified Microsoft ecosystem
* Proven AI literacy for quality, efficiency and productivity
* Excellent communication skills and comfort working with cross functional stakeholders
